verdict.rationale: BugSnag is an error-monitoring/observability SaaS product, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools via MCP; the evidence shows BugSnag ships its own MCP *server* (bugsnag-docs-21, bugsnag-probe-3) for others to connect to, not a client-side capability to plug external MCP servers into BugSnag itself. This client-role axis is a category error for this product type.
